definitions.DISPLAY: calibrated on the 2010-2012 holdout and on 2013-2025, material information beyond a no-market baseline; plain language, market-derived label required
definitions.DISPLAY_WITH_CAUTION: usable but with a visible caveat: either weaker calibration (ECE up to 0.045, a Hosmer-Lemeshow miss) or small information gain; whole percents only
definitions.RESEARCH_ONLY: emitted in the payload for audit; hidden in the UI
definitions.SUPPRESS: not emitted (or stripped) at the source; the UI must also refuse it

halftime.margin_distribution.evidence: CRPS -5.3% / -4.2% vs no-market baseline (holdout / 2013-25); randomized PIT chi2 p 0.94 / 0.29, 50% and 90% coverage 0.510/0.899 and 0.515/0.908

halftime.p_lead_7plus_home.evidence: Brier -7.0% / -5.0% vs no-market baseline; ECE 0.045 holdout (HL p 0.07), 0.020 reused (HL p 0.09)

flow.p_lead_14plus_any_time.evidence: Brier -1.6% / -1.0% (small information); ECE 0.021 / 0.008; HL p 0.21 / 0.01; base rate 0.61

flow.p_within_8_entering_q4.evidence: Brier -0.8% / -0.2%: the line adds almost nothing; base rate ~0.50; forecast range 0.32-0.60; HL p 0.30 / 0.02

flow.p_comeback_10.evidence: no information beyond the 14% base rate (G0 vs no-market +0.19% / -0.02%); no challenger improved it

script.close_win_split.evidence: close_split_calibration.json verdict DO NOT SHOW SPLIT (model - B1 Brier +0.0006, 95% CI [-0.0036, +0.0051] exceeds the +0.002 bar); not enforced anywhere in current code

opportunity.plays.evidence: incumbent volume model vs market-only baseline on 2,702 identical 2021-25 team-games: MAE 6.480 vs 6.542 (-0.96%)

opportunity.rush_attempts.evidence: not scored for the incumbent; designed rushes follow from plays and dropbacks

opportunity.pass_rate.evidence: incumbent pregame pass-rate MAE 0.082 (Exp1); no like-for-like market-only full-game baseline computed

opportunity.drives.evidence: the incumbent does not simulate drives; a new drive model would be a replacement opportunity model

automatic_downgrades.effective_sample_lt_150: one level (27 of 1,351 games in 2021-25, all |spread| >= 14 or extreme totals)
